overall_reason: The gallery page marks the current email and its search dialog behaves, but at 375 the navbar pushes its menu button off the screen, the view tabs wrap, and a fixed legal pill covers the email.

score.reason: T-PHONE-NAV fails twice (CMP-011 menu off-screen, CMP-164 wrapped tabs), and T-INTERRUPT (CMP-014) and T-OVERLAY-CHECK (CMP-013) each find a gap, against a passing T-WHERE-AM-I.

findings.where: div.navbar_container: logo, search box and div.navbar10_menu-button, 375px, fold-375.png and tiles/375-00.png
findings.evidence: At 375 the header shows the logo and a 233 px search box ('Search by c...'). The 40x48 menu button sits past the right edge: the sweep's overflow check reports 'page is 383px wide at a 375px viewport', with the menu icon as the culprit. No menu control shows on the phone's first screen.
findings.before: The phone header pushes its menu button off the screen.
findings.after: Keep a named 'Menu' button inside the 375 header: shrink the search to an icon that opens the search dialog, and make the menu button a <button>.
findings.why: Pricing, Find inspiration, Log In and Sign Up cannot be reached from the phone header without scrolling sideways.
findings.title: The phone gets the whole navigation

findings.where: view tabs: Desktop, Code, Text, Info, Editable templates NEW!, 375px, tiles/375-00.png
findings.evidence: At 375 the five view tabs wrap to two rows: 'Editable templates' and its NEW! badge drop under 'Desktop', 'Code', 'Text' and 'Info'.
findings.before: The view tab row breaks onto two lines on a phone.
findings.after: Let the tab row scroll sideways with the selected tab in view, or shorten 'Editable templates' to 'Templates'.
findings.why: A wrapped tab row reads as two groups and pushes the email further down.
findings.title: Tabs for 2-9 sections with short names, single line, never stacked rows

findings.where: fixed 'Legal and Privacy info' pill (div.hdAwi > button), 1440px and 375px, tiles/1440-00.png and tiles/375-00.png
findings.evidence: A fixed white pill reading 'Legal and Privacy info' stays at the bottom right on every screen. At 375 it covers the email's bottom lines (tiles/375-00.png y 775 to 812).
findings.before: A legal pill floats over the email being shown.
findings.after: Put the legal and privacy links in the page footer and remove the fixed pill.
findings.why: The pill hides part of the email the visitor came to see, on every screen of the page.
findings.title: Nothing interrupts the visitor uninvited

findings.where: nav details > summary 'Find inspiration' mega-menu, 1440px, motion/t3-normal-600.png
findings.evidence: The overlay row for t3 records a 1100x682 panel ('Browse by type', 'Popular right now', ...) and closed_after_escape: false after Escape and a pointer move away.
findings.before: The 'Find inspiration' menu stays open after Escape.
findings.after: Close the menu on Escape and when the pointer leaves, and return focus to 'Find inspiration'.
findings.why: A 1100 px menu that ignores Escape covers most of the page until the visitor clicks elsewhere.
findings.title: Overlays are the last answer and behave as overlays

strengths: The breadcrumb 'Home / See you next week.' marks the current email (a link to this page), and the 'Desktop' view tab carries a filled selected look (tiles/1440-00.png).
The search opens a dialog that closes on Escape (overlay t0, closed_after_escape: true).
The sidebar has one filled action, 'Sign up to Really Good Emails for free', under the line 'Save this email to start commenting'.
The stylesheet declares hover 198, focus-visible 25, active 10, disabled 171, invalid 4 and current 23 rules.
The email shown has one action, the 'Add to calendar' link under the date (tiles/1440-01.png): T-PRIMARY-COUNT passes for the email.
not_investigated: the email itself is the exhibit this page shows. Its links and buttons are judged only as an email (T-PRIMARY-COUNT, T-ONE-FAMILY), not as page controls
the 'Code' tab navigated the page when clicked: not verified
the 'Toggle legal and privacy information' disclosure stays open after Escape, which is normal for a disclosure
T-TABLE-READ, T-EMPTY-FIRST, T-FIRST-RUN: no tables, data regions or first-run path
inline validation and error placement after invalid input: the capture fills valid values and never types an invalid one
what the phone menu holds and how it opens and closes: the capture opens triggers at 1440 only
focus moving into an overlay and back to its trigger, scroll lock and backdrop click: not recorded by the capture
keyboard operation of custom widgets: lens-a11y
flows beyond the captured page and states reached only with real data
